title: Tag SRD weapons with simple/martial and melee/ranged groups
description:
Child of the equipment grouping audit epic.

The SRD weapons table encodes four important groups via table headers:
- Simple Melee Weapons
- Simple Ranged Weapons
- Martial Melee Weapons
- Martial Ranged Weapons

Generated weapon records currently preserve cost, damage, properties, and weight, but do not preserve simple/martial or melee/ranged grouping. This makes class weapon proficiencies and starting-equipment filters impossible to resolve deterministically.

Acceptance criteria:
- Each generated weapon record has structured grouping metadata equivalent to:
  - weaponCategory: simple | martial
  - weaponRange: melee | ranged
- The metadata is derived deterministically from the SRD table grouping, not manually patched in the generated pack.
- Starting-equipment filters for martial melee weapons and similar weapon choices can enumerate concrete candidates.
- Class proficiencies for Simple weapons and martial weapons can resolve to concrete weapon records.
- Add regression tests for representative simple melee, simple ranged, martial melee, and martial ranged weapons.
close_reason: Tagged all 37 weapons with weaponCategory/weaponRange derived from the Weapons table sub-headers
